watch.summary: The streamer spectates a player seamlessly blending into a painting during a hide-and-seek game and roasts his own previous attempt at hiding in the same spot.

beats.what: Streamer spectates Lorenz hiding flat against a wall painting.
Streamer points out how flat Lorenz looks compared to his own character.
He recalls his own bad hiding attempt where his character's butt was larger than Lorenz's entire body.
He describes how his character was bulging out of the painting and breaks out laughing.
He settles down and notices how many players have been found so far.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I was just bulging out of the painting!
watch.why: The streamer's hilarious self-deprecation about his oversized character model bulging out of a painting creates a funny visual contrast with the player he is spectating.
